description: This file defines the CommentStatistics class in the Drupal comment module, responsible for storing, retrieving, updating, and deleting comment statistics related to entities, including methods for reading statistics, creating new entries, deleting, updating, and obtaining ranking info.

classes.name: CommentStatistics
classes.description: Service class for managing comment statistics, including reading, creating, updating, deleting, and ranking comment data associated with entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the CommentStatistics service with database connections, current user, entity type manager, state, and time services.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves comment statistics for given entities, optionally using an accurate database connection.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes comment statistics for a specific entity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates comment statistics entries for an entity with specified fields.

methods.name: getMaximumCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum comment count for a given entity type.

methods.name: getRankingInfo
methods.description: Provides ranking information based on comment counts, including join conditions and scoring formula.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates comment statistics based on a comment object, recalculating counts and last comment info.
